commands:
echo ADB; adb devices -l; echo STATUS; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py status; echo SPEECH_AUTH; TMP=$(mktemp -d); cat > "$TMP/check.swift" <<'SWIFT'
import Foundation
import Speech
print(SFSpeechRecognizer.authorizationStatus().rawValue)
SWIFT
swift "$TMP/check.swift"; rm -rf "$TMP"

STATE=$(adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); if [ "$STATE" = "2" ]; then mkdir -p /tmp/aicallbridge-live; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py capture 3000 /tmp/aicallbridge-live/now.wav; ls -l /tmp/aicallbridge-live/now.wav; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift /tmp/aicallbridge-live/now.wav || true; else echo NO_ACTIVE_CALL_CAPTURE_SKIPPED; fi
